---
title: Mermaid
---

MERMAID_PAGE_MARKER

A mermaid fence must render as a diagram (a client Mermaid component, SSR'd as a container with
aria-label="Diagram"), NOT as a Shiki-highlighted code block. This page has no other fenced code,
so the presence of Shiki markup would mean the fence wasn't transformed.

```mermaid
graph TD
  A[Start] --> B[End]
```
